pokedexEntries.ru: This POKéMON has a body of steel. To make its body, ARON feeds on iron ore that it digs from mountains. Occasionally, it causes major trouble by eating bridges and rails.

pokedexEntries.sa: ARON has a body of steel. With one all-out charge, this POKéMON can demolish even a heavy dump truck. The destroyed dump truck then becomes a handy meal for the POKéMON.

pokedexEntries.frlg: It eats iron to build its steel body. It is a pest that descends from mountains to eat bridges and train tracks.

pokedexEntries.em: A POKéMON that is clad in steel armor. A new suit of armor is made when it evolves. The old, discarded armor is salvaged as metal for making iron products.

pokedexEntries.dpp: It usually lives deep in mountains. However, hunger may drive it to eat railroad tracks and cars.

pokedexEntries.hgss: When it evolves, it sheds the steel carapace that covered its whole body and develops a new one.

pokedexEntries.bw: It usually lives deep in mountains. However, hunger may drive it to eat railroad tracks and cars.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: In order to build up its steel body, it eats iron ore. This pesky Pokémon is known to eat railroad tracks.

pokedexEntries.x: It usually lives deep in mountains. However, hunger may drive it to eat railroad tracks and cars.

pokedexEntries.y: When it evolves, it sheds the steel carapace that covered its whole body and develops a new one.

pokedexEntries.or: This Pokémon has a body of steel. To make its body, Aron feeds on iron ore that it digs from mountains. Occasionally, it causes major trouble by eating bridges and rails.

pokedexEntries.as: Aron has a body of steel. With one all-out charge, this Pokémon can demolish even a heavy dump truck. The destroyed dump truck then becomes a handy meal for the Pokémon.

pokedexEntries.sw: It eats iron ore—and sometimes railroad tracks—to build up the steel armor that protects its body.

pokedexEntries.sh: When Aron evolves, its steel armor peels off. In ancient times, people would collect Aron’s shed armor and make good use of it in their daily lives.

pokedexEntries.bdsp: It usually lives deep in mountains. But when it’s hungry, it shows up at the foot of the mountains and eats railroad tracks and cars.

pokedexEntries.za: When it evolves, it sheds the steel carapace that covered its whole body and develops a new one.
